department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: The page gives no PhD application deadline.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission for the PhD.

funding.quote: Fellowships and/or assistantships may be available for well-qualified students admitted into the graduate program.

entry_route.quote: An undergraduate degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related fields.

notes: The department's PhD is in Computer Engineering, offered jointly with the University of Alabama in Huntsville. The department also offers an M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering (not saved). The page says international applicants must meet the Graduate School's English rule; no department score is given.
